SELECT products.product_id, products.product_name, products.product_type, SUM(order_items.product_price) AS beverage_revenue
FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."order_items" AS order_items
JOIN "jaffle_shop"."dev"."products" AS products ON order_items.product_id = products.product_id
WHERE products.is_drink_item = 1
GROUP BY products.product_id, products.product_name, products.product_type
ORDER BY beverage_revenue DESC
